bull_bear.body: Intense competition in the auto components industry; Regulatory changes affecting the automotive sector
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: The company's diversified product portfolio and strong relationships with major automotive OEMs provide a competitive advantage
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Business restructuring during FY 26: "the business of Castings & Sheet Metal was restructured into wholly owned subsidiaries during FY 26", which the deck flags makes previous and corresponding-quarter standalone figures not comparable.
- ₹341 Crs of investment is currently parked in four new India projects that are yet to achieve volumes and carry a PBT loss in the quarter, so near-term returns are pre-ramp.
- Capability expansion is split between wholly owned subsidiaries (castings, sheet metal, EV powertrain, after market) and joint ventures with Korean/Taiwanese partners for electronics and smart products, rather than a single-entity build.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Strategically Located Plants across all major auto hubs" with a global and domestic footprint: India 34 plants, Overseas 4 plants, JV 6 plants and 1 R&D Centre.
- Diversified customer-category exposure across 2W, 3W, 4W (PV & CV) and OHV (off-highway vehicles), so no single vehicle segment carries the whole portfolio.
- Technology access is structured through joint ventures with South Korean, Taiwanese and Indian partners (Sandhar Amkin, Sandhar Whetron Electronics, Sandhar Han Sung Technologies, Winnercom Sandhar Technologies, Sandhar Han Shin Auto Technologies), with the parent described as supplying "Technologically Advanced & Smart Products".
- Group is organised as a listed parent (Sandhar Technologies Ltd) plus wholly owned subsidiaries by capability — Ascast (aluminium & zinc die casting), Auto Castings (machining for casting), Engineering (sheet metal fabrication), Automotive Systems (B2C after market), Auto Electric Solutions (powertrain & EV) and Technologies Barcelona SL (aluminium die casting holding co.).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] The new-projects table lists an "SCL Acquired Business" at Hosur under Sandhar Ascast Pvt Ltd (ADC - HPDC & LPDC), with turnaround expected by Q4 FY-27; the deck gives no acquisition consideration or date.
- [Regulatory cost] Statutory minimum wage revisions in Haryana & Uttarakhand are called out as a distinct P&L impact (Rs. 5.84 Crs consolidated, Rs. 3.08 Crs standalone), indicating a recurring labour-cost step-up rather than a one-off.
- [Contradiction] The deck states two different PBT losses from new projects for the same quarter: Rs. 7.41 Crs (described as from new projects in India, on the Financial Summary slide and matching the New Projects table PBT of (-)7.41) and Rs. 4.81 Crs (in the Consolidated Financial Performance note). Both readings are reported as printed.
